# Life of Adam and Eve Chapter 13 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Latin MS (Vita Adae et Evae) | **Section:** Seth's Birth; Adam's Lineage Begins

---

**1** Seth was born and Adam and Eve were overjoyed. Eve said: 'God has given me another child to take the place of Abel, who was killed by Cain.'

**2** Seth grew up and was filled with wisdom. He walked with God all his life.

**3** In those days Adam began to teach Seth all his wisdom and the ways of God.

**4** Adam said to Seth: 'Listen to me, my son. Remember everything I tell you — all that I have seen and experienced in paradise.'

---
*PNEUMA: modern English; verse-only numbering.*
